subject.en: Central crest motif: Nothing inside the door-shaped outline, no leaf, ring or motif, only one tiny warm white point of light at its very center.

extra.en: Frame: the End. No ornament at all, only a single fine line of door gold outlining a door, with no steps beneath it.
